findings.title: The frozen head has not run in a real Claude Code session; the host's fs.stat symlink semantics are mock-tested only.
findings.body: Raised by: both auditors (Grok HIGH, AGY HIGH). Adjudication: CONFIRMED (live gap); AGY's stat(resolve) doubt is not supported by the local declaration (isLink describes the path itself; resolve only adds realPath), live behaviour UNVERIFIABLE. GATES_PRE_AUDIT.txt records the live check as NOT_RUN; README and how-to say NOT VERIFIED. Operator step: load the frozen head in a real session, one pinned advisor-calling child, one clean child, one unpinned Agent call, /route-ledger, /route-ledger receipts, a /clear (note the session id), a symlinked relative receiptDir.

findings.title: /route-ledger receipts typed right after /clear, before the next hook, prints receipt file none and receiptsEnabled false.
findings.body: Raised by: AGY only (its N2). Adjudication: CONFIRMED. register.tsx:270-279 (freshSession), :636-647 (receiptsText), :1293-1306 (command.run handlers do not call ensureReady). State quirk, no data loss; how-to line 142 says the table and counts are empty until the next recorded event.

findings.title: The first unpinned Agent call after a start or /clear loses its in-memory toast-once entry when initSession replaces the set.
findings.body: Raised by: AGY only (its N3). Adjudication: CONFIRMED (mechanism); impact bounded. register.tsx:1147-1156 adds the id and shows the toast before recordAgentRequest/ensureReady runs initSession (:931-937, toasted new Set at :286). The toast was already shown; only a repeated identical tool_use id could toast twice.

findings.title: A segment holding an Agent request whose agent.spawn never completes or is denied is never evicted from memory.
findings.body: Raised by: AGY only (its N4). Adjudication: CONFIRMED; by design, disclosed. register.tsx:739-757 (holdsUnjoined, evictClosed), :1235 (noteSpawn returns on deny). README Memory and the how-to say such a segment stays whole.
